_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Jogadór Snake on a {width}×{height} grid.
Bo kontrola snake {player_id}. Movimentu balidu: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ó w/s/a/d).
Objektivu: sobrevivi máis longu ó sea máis longu i alcança score máis altu (limiti di turnu {max_turns} turnu).

game_action.invalid_death: Serpenti {player_id} móre pamodi un mudansa inválidu.

outcome.survived_win: Jogador {player_id} sobrevive; tudu kes otu morri.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Tudu kes kóbra móre na mésmu óra.
outcome.outlived: Kel jugador li vive más di ki tudu kes otu.
outcome.turn_limit: Txiga limiti di txon - midjór pontu ta ganha na disputa.
